title: debark doctor report v1
description: debark.doctorreport/v1 - what is likely to go wrong on the far side of the gap: maintainer scripts that want the network, snap shim packages, DKMS packages without matching headers, and redistribution terms. Emitted by `debark doctor --json`. Every finding is a heuristic and says so: wording is deliberately "no obvious network action found", never "proven safe". doctor never fails a build by itself; policy does that.

checked_at.description: When this report was produced, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

summary.description: Finding counts keyed by severity, for a one-line human summary. Deliberately open-ended: keys are the severities actually seen.

check.description: Which heuristic produced this finding. Stable: scripts and policy files reference these identifiers.

severity.description: doctor's own severity scale. Distinct from policy severity, which additionally has "deny".

package.description: Package this finding is about, when it is about one package.

evidence.description: The concrete thing that triggered this finding: a matched script line, a component name, a missing header package name.

flag.description: The lock flag this finding corresponds to, when there is a matching one.
